parts.label: (a)
parts.answer: The graph is the inverted parabola $v=12t-t^2-20$ on $0\leq t\leq12$, starting at $(0,-20)$, crossing $v=0$ at $t=2$ and $t=10$, and ending at $(12,-20)$.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Attempt to integrate $12-2t$ — M1. For integration, the power of $t$ must increase by 1 in at least 1 term with a change of coefficient in the same term. No $+c$ required for this mark. $s=vt$ is M0.

$v=12t-\dfrac{2t^2}{2}(+c)=12t-t^2(+c)$ — A1. No $+c$ required for this mark; allow unsimplified.

Use boundary conditions to get $c=-20$ — B1.

Solve $12t-t^2-20=0$ to get $t=2$ and $t=10$ — B1, soi.

Correct graph: inverted quadratic starting at $(0,-20)$ and ending at $(12,-20)$ — B1. Ignore anything outside $0\leq t\leq12$; $t=2$ and $t=10$ need not be shown.

Total: 5.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Attempt to integrate their $12t-t^2-20$ — *M1. Integrating their 2- or 3-term expression for $v$ from (a) which has come from integration. For integration, the power of $t$ must increase by 1 in at least 1 term with a change of coefficient in the same term.

$s=\left[\dfrac{12}{2}t^2-\dfrac13t^3-20t(+d)\right]=6t^2-\dfrac13t^3-20t(+d)$ — A1ft. ft their $+c\ne0$; allow unsimplified.

Attempt to evaluate their $\left[6t^2-\dfrac13t^3-20t\right]$ for any of $t=0$ to $t=\text{their }2$, or $t=\text{their }2$ to $t=\text{their }10$, or $t=\text{their }10$ to $t=12$ — DM1. Correct use of correct limits for one time interval.

Attempt to evaluate it for all three intervals — DM1. Correct use of correct limits for all 3 time intervals; ignore signs here. $s=-\left(-\dfrac{56}{3}-[0]\right)+\left(\dfrac{200}{3}-\left(-\dfrac{56}{3}\right)\right)-\left(48-\dfrac{200}{3}\right)=\dfrac{368}{3}\approx123\,\mathrm{m}$ — A1, AWRT 123.

Printed exactly in the official scheme: either $s=\left|\int_0^2\left(6t^2-\dfrac13t^3-20t\right)dt\right|=\dfrac{56}{3}=18.7$, or $s=\int_2^{10}\left(6t^2-\dfrac13t^3-20t\right)dt=\dfrac{256}{3}=85.3$, or $s=\left|\int_{10}^{12}\left(6t^2-\dfrac13t^3-20t\right)dt\right|=\dfrac{56}{3}=18.7$ — B1. The official guidance prints: allow $\int_{10}^{20}|0.25t^2-8t+60|dt=26$. Then $s=\left[\dfrac{56}{3}+\dfrac{256}{3}+\dfrac{56}{3}\right]=\dfrac{368}{3}\approx123\,\mathrm{m}$ — B1, AWRT 123. The official guidance prints: allow $s=\int_0^{12}\left|6t^2-\dfrac13t^3-20t\right|dt=\dfrac{368}{3}\approx123\,\mathrm{m}$ for B2.

Total: 5.
